exposure: eGFR prior to pregnancy of < 60 ml/min/1.73m2
outcome: progression to End Stage Kidney Disease (ESKD)
cohort: The study included female subjects from the University of Iowa's C3G Natural History Study who had at least one pregnancy and available renal and obstetric data.
finding: Pregnancy in mothers with C3 Glomerulopathy (C3G + P) is associated with an increased risk of preeclampsia and prematurity, and a small but significant post-pregnancy decrease in maternal renal function, without an excess risk of spontaneous miscarriage.
